rows.note: This is the usual all-purpose term for a medicine capsule.

example.english: I’ll take this capsule before I go to sleep.
example.traditional: 我食咗呢粒膠囊先瞓覺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 ni1 lap1 gaau1 nong4 sin1 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this for the crew-containing detachable section of a spacecraft.

example.english: The capsule successfully separated from the rocket.
example.traditional: 太空艙成功同火箭分離。
example.jyutping: taai3 hung1 cong1 sing4 gung1 tung4 fo2 zin3 fan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for one of the tiny rooms in a capsule hotel.

example.english: This capsule room is tiny, but it is enough for one night.
example.traditional: 呢間膠囊房好細，不過瞓一晚都夠晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gaau1 nong4 fong2 hou2 sai3 bat1 gwo3 fan3 jat1 maan5 dou1 gau3 saai3
